# Sugggest

> Sugggest is a trusted software discovery and reviews platform featuring expert recommendations, user ratings, and detailed product comparisons across 66,000+ software applications.

Sugggest helps users discover, compare, and evaluate software products through community reviews and expert insights. The platform covers a wide range of categories including developer tools, productivity software, security applications, and multimedia tools across Windows, Linux, and cloud platforms.

## Core Discovery & Browsing

- [Sugggest Homepage](https://sugggest.com): Sugggest homepage: software discovery, expert reviews, and trusted recommendations platform
- [Browse Software Categories](https://sugggest.com/browse): Browse 66,893 software products across 27 categories for software discovery
- [Discover Featured Software](https://sugggest.com/discover): Microsoft OneNote product page: digital notebook with cloud sync and collaboration

## Developer Tools & Infrastructure

- [Visual Studio Code Reviews](https://sugggest.com/software/visual-studio-code): Visual Studio Code: free open-source code editor with Git and debugging support
- [Elasticsearch Reviews](https://sugggest.com/software/elasticsearch): Elasticsearch: open-source search and analytics engine with full-text search
- [Vercel Deployment Platform Reviews](https://sugggest.com/software/vercel/reviews): Vercel deployment platform reviews: Next.js hosting and GitHub integration
- [AWS Firecracker Reviews](https://sugggest.com/software/aws-firecracker): AWS Firecracker: open source virtualization for serverless and container computing

## Security & Privacy Tools

- [Entropy Password Manager Reviews](https://sugggest.com/software/entropy): Entropy: open source password manager with AES-256 encryption and plugins
- [ShuffleHex Password Manager Reviews](https://sugggest.com/software/shufflehex): ShuffleHex: free password manager with AES-256 encryption and cloud sync
- [Fileaudit Security Reviews](https://sugggest.com/software/fileaudit/reviews): Fileaudit reviews: file security monitoring and access auditing tool
- [Ultimate Extract and Recover Reviews](https://sugggest.com/software/ultimate-extract-and-recover): Ultimate Extract and Recover: data recovery software for deleted files and formats
